spots.name: Black Lives Matter Street Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Black Lives Matter Street Mural, a mural by Shawn Fitzwater from 2020. It shows Black Lives Matter. Street mural painted on 1st Avenue South in front of Railroad Park, between 16th and 17th Streets South, initiated by Black Lives Matter Birmingham and artist Shawn Fitzwater with approval from the Mayor's office, completed ahead of Juneteenth 2020.
